description:
`scripts/cargo-ci.sh` exports `TMPDIR` to a scratch directory that it removes on exit. An sccache server first started inside a CI run inherits that `TMPDIR`; after the run every compile through that server fails with `sccache: error: Failed to create temp dir`, in every checkout on the host.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: An sccache server started during a `scripts/cargo-ci.sh` run keeps working after the run's scratch directory is removed, shown by a self-test or a recorded reproduction with exact commands.
- [hard] REQ-02: Test processes still place their scratch trees under the run's scratch directory, and the fixture-leak check is unchanged.
title: cargo-ci leaves an sccache server bound to its deleted scratch TMPDIR
